description.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Kamloops is a mid-range chain hotel located in Kamloops, BC, a major hub on popular touring routes including the Trans Canada and Crowsnest corridors. As part of the Wyndham brand, it offers standard hotel services in a city with good access to services, restaurants, and supply shops. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops will find this a convenient overnight option in an otherwise large, spread-out city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content retrieved is almost entirely Wyndham Hotels booking portal navigation UI with no property-specific amenity details for the Kamloops location; no mention of bike storage, laundry, breakfast, or other cyclist-relevant amenities. OSM provides the core identifiers (address, phone, internet_access=wlan) which are used as the contact baseline. Wi-Fi is supported by OSM tag internet_access=wlan but cannot be independently confirmed from the website content. All other amenity fields remain null due to absence of evidence.
concerns: Website content retrieved was almost entirely Wyndham booking portal UI with no property-specific amenity details; cyclist-relevant amenities could not be verified from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating chain hotel in a major BC touring hub. Useful overnight stop for cyclists regardless of confirmed cyclist-specific amenities.
